title: .cuevik/config.json
description: Project facts for the cuevik plugins, committed in the project repo. Owner/repo come from the git remote; the worktree root is plugin userConfig. Neither belongs here.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Increase it when a key is added, removed or renamed.

boardState.description: Whether the repo has a GitHub Projects (v2) board the plugins use. `configured`: a board is recorded in `project` and everything bootstrap requires of it is done. `partial`: a board is recorded but a part is incomplete, listed in `missing`. `none`: no board is recorded (declined, or it could not be used); a valid state, not an error.

missing.description: Only with `boardState` `partial`. The parts of the board that are incomplete: `link` (board not linked to the repo), `items` (an initiation issue is not on the board), `fields` (a value bootstrap tried to set on a field the board has could not be set), `workflows` (a required workflow is off or its Status mapping is unconfirmed; required = all seven on a board bootstrap created, `Item closed` on an existing one). A field or option the board simply lacks is not listed.

project.description: The GitHub Projects (v2) board that issues are added to and whose Status field cuevik-ship moves. Present when `boardState` is `configured` or `partial`; absent when it is `none`.

owner.description: Login of the user or organisation that owns the board. Can differ from the repo owner.

number.description: Board number, as used by `gh project ... <number> --owner <owner>`.

id.description: Board node id, as used by `gh project item-edit --project-id`.
Field node id, as used by `gh project item-edit --field-id`.

options.description: Every Status option on the board: option name -> option id (`--single-select-option-id`). Names are the board's own.

initiation.description: The issues that track cuevik-start's steps, written by 00-bootstrap and added to the board when there is one. Required in every `boardState`: the issues are filed without a board. All carry the `initiation` label and never `epic` or `story`, so backlog tooling never reads them. The runner puts `Closes #<story>` in each step's PR body; status cross-checks their state against the merged PRs.

epic.description: Issue number of the Initiation epic. The last step's PR closes it.

stories.description: Step id -> issue number of that step's story. One per step except 00-bootstrap, whose story cannot exist before bootstrap runs.
